ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText:
Where in the world
is VIRIDIAN's GYM

LEADER? I wanted
to challenge him.
ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText_Blu:
There are no GYM
TRAINERS at the VIRIDIAN GYM.

The LEADER claims
his policy is to

win without having
any underlings.
ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
I heard that the
GYM in CINNABAR is gone.

I wonder what be-
came of BLAINE, the GYM LEADER.
ViridianPokecenter1FBugCatcherText:
My dream is to be-
come a GYM LEADER.
